system.description:
You point your hand at your target and mimic a gun with your finger, generating a ball of water at your fingertip that you use to fire a burst stream of water bullets fast and forceful enough to tear through stone.

All creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 cold damage and are Bruised on a failure, or half as much on a success.

Hydrofication. This jutsu’s range instead becomes a 30-foot long, 5-foot-wide line, and all creatures in range, make their saving throw at disadvantage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, creatures that fail their saving throw are Shaken. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the size of the cone or line by +20 feet. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, creatures that fail their saving throw are Staggered.
